data.name: sync_notes_ai
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER sync_notes_ai AFTER INSERT ON notes
WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_mute) BEGIN
  INSERT INTO sync_outbox (tbl, row_id, deleted, seq)
  VALUES ('notes', new.id, 0, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1 FROM sync_outbox))
  ON CONFLICT (tbl, row_id) DO UPDATE
    SET deleted = excluded.deleted, seq = excluded.seq;
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_outbox" ("tbl" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE, "seq" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(tbl, row_id));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_remote" ("name" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "file_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "modified" TEXT);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_mute" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "notes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "content_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "plain_text" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "tags" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "is_pinned" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_pinned" IN (0, 1)), "is_favourite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_favourite" IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_archived" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER sync_notes_ai AFTER INSERT ON notes WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_mute) BEGIN INSERT INTO sync_outbox (tbl, row_id, deleted, seq) VALUES ('notes', new.id, 0, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1 FROM sync_outbox)) ON CONFLICT (tbl, row_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = excluded.deleted, seq = excluded.seq;END

CREATE TRIGGER sync_notes_au AFTER UPDATE ON notes WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_mute) BEGIN INSERT INTO sync_outbox (tbl, row_id, deleted, seq) VALUES ('notes', new.id, 0, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1 FROM sync_outbox)) ON CONFLICT (tbl, row_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = excluded.deleted, seq = excluded.seq;END

CREATE TRIGGER sync_notes_ad AFTER DELETE ON notes WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_mute) BEGIN INSERT INTO sync_outbox (tbl, row_id, deleted, seq) VALUES ('notes', old.id, 1, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1 FROM sync_outbox)) ON CONFLICT (tbl, row_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = excluded.deleted, seq = excluded.seq;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "note_attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES notes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "file_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "original_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TRIGGER sync_note_attachments_ai AFTER INSERT ON note_attachments WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_mute) BEGIN INSERT INTO sync_outbox (tbl, row_id, deleted, seq) VALUES ('note_attachments', new.id, 0, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1 FROM sync_outbox)) ON CONFLICT (tbl, row_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = excluded.deleted, seq = excluded.seq;END

CREATE TRIGGER sync_note_attachments_au AFTER UPDATE ON note_attachments WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sync_mute) BEGIN INSERT INTO sync_outbox (tbl, row_id, deleted, seq) VALUES ('note_attachments', new.id, 0, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) + 1 FROM sync_outbox)) ON CONFLICT (tbl, row_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted = excluded.deleted, seq = excluded.seq;END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tasks" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "due_date" TEXT NULL, "reminder_at" TEXT NULL, "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_completed" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
